description: This file defines the AttributeDeleted class, representing an event indicating that an attribute was deleted from a 'Thing'. It includes methods for constructing instances, serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event data.

classes.name: AttributeDeleted
classes.description: An immutable class representing an event for when a Thing attribute is deleted, including serialization/deserialization and event-specific data access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs an AttributeDeleted event with specified parameters, allowing optional metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributeDeleted instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer identifying the deleted attribute.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path of the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with the specified Ditto headers.
